narrative.overview: 拾句 is set as a diary page left open at night: dates in the left margin, one margin rule, the copied lines to its right, and a lamp above. The margin, the rule and the lamp carry the character; the quotes stay calm in a readable hand face. Dark because of the use scene, never pure white or pure black.
keyCharacteristics: Every quote is a diary entry with its date in the margin
A lamp glow fixed to the top of the viewport; the newest quote sits under it
No rules between quotes; margin dates and whitespace separate them
Hierarchy from size and tone, never cards or shadows
Tags set as a notebook index: name, dotted leader, count

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: Lamp amber marks only what is current or just happened: the active filter, search hits, a successful copy, clear filters, the note rule, the faint margin rule, the subtitle, focus, selection and caret.

rules.name: One lamp
rules.body: The only depth on the page is the fixed glow and the paper grain; no shadows, cards or second gradient.

dos: Do make emphasis with size or tone
Do keep every quote's source and tags clickable
Do keep the lamp and the grain fixed to the viewport
donts: Don't use a pure white or pure black ground
Don't add rules, cards, shadows or fills between quotes
Don't colour the tags under a quote with lamp amber
Don't add inline scripts, inline styles or third-party resources; the CSP allows same-origin only
